struct.name: WID_STAT
struct.doc: Widget status, the second word of the standard widget configuration block (`p_wid_stat`). Offset, width and name are the header definition. Access direction is not stated by the header or by any code read; nothing in the SN2 driver or the IRIX objects reaches this register, so its behaviour is unknown.

Access direction is not stated by the header or by any code read; nothing in the SN2 driver or the IRIX objects reaches this register, so its behaviour is unknown.

struct.name: INT_ATE_MP
